column1: Across both projects, several defects shared one shape: the parking lot's release() printing a message and returning; the vending machine's cancel() announcing a refund that never moved money; and the snake's occupied Set silently dropping a cell the body still held. What do all three have in common?,All three were caused by missing null checks,"Each one carried on normally after doing nothing or doing only part of the job, so nothing at the moment of failure distinguished it from success - the damage only surfaced later, somewhere else",All three were concurrency problems,All three were caused by inheritance being used incorrectly,,2,"The recurring lesson across the whole term: the expensive bugs are the quiet ones. Throwing, or returning a result the caller must inspect, would have surfaced all three at the point they actually went wrong.",2
